G4211.d: feminine of a compound of πορφύρα and πωλέω; a female trader in purple cloth:--seller of purple.

G4017.d: from περί and βλέπω; to look all around:--look (round) about (on).

G4046.d: middle voice from περί and ποιέω; to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy):--purchase.

G4024.d: from περί and ζώννυμι; to gird all around, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively):--gird (about, self).

G4008.d: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of (to "pierce"); through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across:--beyond, farther (other) side, over.

G4385.d: from πρό and (to stretch); to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging):--bind.

G4494.d: from a derivative of ῥίπτω (meaning a fan or bellows); to breeze up, i.e. (by analogy) to agitate (into waves):--toss.

G4439.d: apparently a primary word; a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively):--gate.

G4090.d: adverb from πικρός; bitterly, i.e. (figuratively) violently:--bitterly.

G4035.d: from περί and λείπω; to leave all around, i.e. (passively) survive:--remain.

G4382.d: from προσωπολήπτης; partiality, i.e. favoritism:--respect of persons.

G4174.d: from πολίτης ("polity"); citizenship; concretely, a community:--commonwealth, freedom.

G4068.d: middle voice from (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the base of πέραν); to boast:--vaunt itself.

G4049.d: from περί and σπάω; to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to distract (with care):--cumber.

G4333.d: from πρός and ἐργάζομαι; to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides:--gain.

G4097.d: contracted from (to traverse; from the base of πέραν); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively):--sell.

G4470.d: from ῥήγνυμι; a "rag," i.e. piece of cloth:--cloth.

G4107.d: from πλάνος; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher:--wandering.

G4064.d: from περί and φέρω; to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither:--bear (carry) about.

G4053.d: from περί (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with ἐκ) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence:--exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly).

G4349.d: from προσκόπτω; a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin:--offence.

G4196.d: of Latin origin; apparently "popular"; Poplius (i.e. Publius), a Roman:--Publius.

G4127.d: from πλήσσω; a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity:--plague, stripe, wound(-ed).

G4368.d: feminine of a derivative of προΐστημι; a patroness, i.e. assistant:--succourer.

G4148.d: from πλοῦτος; to make wealthy (figuratively):--en- (make) rich.

G4476.d: from a primary (to sew; perhaps rather akin to the base of ῥαπίζω through the idea of puncturing); a needle:-- needle.

G4200.d: from a derivative of (a way, i.e. means); furnishing (procuring), i.e. (by implication) money-getting (acquisition):--gain.

G4256.d: from πρό and a derivative of αἰτία; to accuse already, i.e. previously charge:--prove before.

G4151.d: from πνέω; a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit:--ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind. Compare ψυχή.

G4459.d: adverb from the base of ποῦ; an interrogative particle of manner; in what way? (sometimes the question is indirect, how?); also as exclamation, how much!:--how, after (by) what manner (means), that. (Occasionally unexpressed in English).

G4296.d: from πρό and κηρύσσω; to herald (i.e. proclaim) in advance:--before (first) preach.

G4013.d: from περί and ἄγω; to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to walk around:--compass, go (round) about, lead about.

G4042.d: from περιέχω; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed):--place.

G4165.d: from ποιμήν; to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser):--feed (cattle), rule.

G4357.d: from πρός and μένω; to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in:--abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with).

G4270.d: from πρό and γράφω; to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe:--before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime).

G4454.d: apparently a primary word; a "foal" or "filly", i.e. (specially), a young ass:--colt.

G4335.d: from προσεύχομαι; prayer (worship); by implication, an oratory (chapel):--X pray earnestly, prayer.

G4272.d: from πρό and δίδωμι; to give before the other party has given:--first give.

G4351.d: from πρός and κυλιόω; to roll towards, i.e. block against:--roll (to).

G4398.d: feminine of προφήτης; a female foreteller or an inspired woman:--prophetess.

G4243.d: from the base of πρεσβύτερος; to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher):--be an ambassador.

G4173.d: from πόλις and ἄρχω; a town-officer, i.e. magistrate:--ruler of the city.

G4325.d: from πρός and δαπανάω; to expend additionally:--spend more.

G4058.d: of uncertain derivation; a pigeon:--dove, pigeon.

G4465.d: from ῥάβδος and ἔχω; a rod- (the Latin fasces) holder, i.e. a Roman lictor (constable or executioner):--serjeant.

G4115.d: from πλατύς; to widen (literally or figuratively):--make broad, enlarge.

G4204.d: feminine of πόρνος; a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater:--harlot, whore.

G4386.d: neuter of πρότερος as adverb (with or without the article); previously:--before, (at the) first, former.

G4324.d: from πρός and ἀπειλέω; to menace additionally:--i.e. threaten further.

G4016.d: from περί and βάλλω; to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade or with clothing):--array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on.

G4311.d: from πρό and πέμπω; to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel:--accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.

G4225.d: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun (some) otherwise obsolete (compare πόσος); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly:--about, a certain place.

G4230.d: from πραγματεύομαι; a transaction, i.e. negotiation:--affair.

G4241.d: apparently a primary verb; to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right):--become, comely.

G4048.d: from περί and ῥήγνυμι; to tear all around, i.e. completely away:--rend off.

G4131.d: from πλήσσω; a smiter, i.e. pugnacious (quarrelsome):--striker.

G4320.d: from πρός and ἀναβαίνω; to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat):--go up.

G4389.d: middle voice from πρό and the base of τροπή; to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage:--exhort.

G4294.d: from πρό and καταρτίζω; to prepare in advance:--make up beforehand.

G4108.d: of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader; --deceiver, seducing.

G4130.d: a prolonged form of a primary (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form pimplemi); to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time):--accomplish, full (…come), furnish.

G4164.d: of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. various in character:--divers, manifold.

G4279.d: middle voice from πρό and ἐπαγγέλλω; to promise of old:--promise before.

G4319.d: from πρός and αἰτέω; to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. solicit:--beg.

G4327.d: from πρός and δέχομαι; to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience):--accept, allow, look (wait) for, take.

G4244.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of πρεσβύτερος; the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery":--(estate of) elder(-s), presbytery.

G4433.d: from πτωχός; to be a beggar, i.e. (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively):--become poor.

G4178.d: multiplicative adverb from πολύς; many times, i.e. frequently:--oft(-en, -entimes, -times).

G4315.d: from πρό and σάββατον; a fore-sabbath, i.e. the Sabbath-eve:--day before the sabbath. Compare παρασκευή.

G4499.d: probably from (a rose); Rhodus, an island of the Mediterranean:--Rhodes.

G4475.d: from ῥαπίζω; a slap:--(+ strike with the) palm of the hand, smite with the hand.

G4227.d: of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian:--Pudens.

G4358.d: from πρός and a derivative of the same as ὁρμή (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull); to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at:--draw to the shore.

G4144.d: from πλέω; a sail, i.e. navigation:--course, sailing, voyage.

G4229.d: from πράσσω; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material):--business, matter, thing, work.

G4197.d: from πορεύομαι; travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career:--journey(-ing), ways.

G4468.d: from the same as ῥᾳδιούργημα; recklessness, i.e. (by extension) malignity:--mischief.

G4259.d: neuter of a presumed compound of πρό and αὐλή; a forecourt, i.e. vestibule (alley-way):--porch.

G4067.d: from a comparative of περί and (to rub); something brushed all around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum):--offscouring.

G4012.d: from the base of πέραν; properly, through (all over), i.e. around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period):--(there-)about, above, against, at, on behalf of, X and his company, which concern, (as) concerning, for, X how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on, over, pertaining (to), for sake, X (e-)state, (as) touching, (where-)by (in), with. In comparative, it retains substantially the same meaning of circuit (around), excess (beyond), or completeness (through).

G4414.d: from πρῶτος and ἵστημι; one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion):--ringleader.

G4252.d: diminutive of Πρίσκα; Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian woman:--Priscilla.

G4282.d: from πρό and ἑτοιμάζω; to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively):--ordain before, prepare afore.

G4187.d: adverb from a compound of πολύς and τρόπος; in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form:--in divers manners.

G4342.d: from πρός and καρτερέω; to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor):--attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually).

G4444.d: apparently a primary word ("burgh"); a tower or castle:--tower.

G4220.d: neuter of a comparative of the base of ποῦ; interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that:--whether.

G4460.d: of Hebrew origin (רָחָב); Raab (i.e. Rachab), a Canaanitess:--Rahab. See also Ῥαχάβ.

G4020.d: from περί and ἐργάζομαι; to work all around, i.e. bustle about (meddle):--be a busybody.

G4112.d: from πλάσσω; moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false):--feigned.

G4184.d: from πολύς and σπλάγχνον (figuratively); extremely compassionate:--very pitiful.

G4461.d: of Hebrew origin (רַב with pronominal suffix); my master, i.e Rabbi, as an official title of honor:--Master, Rabbi.

G4043.d: from περί and πατέω; to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary):--go, be occupied with, walk (about).

G4332.d: from a compound of πρός and the base of ἑδραῖος; to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant:--wait at.

G4374.d: from πρός and φέρω (including its alternate); to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat:--bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to.

G4171.d: from (to bustle); warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series):--battle, fight, war.

G4331.d: from πρός and ἐγγίζω; to approach near:--come nigh.

G4150.d: a prolonged form of an obsolete (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e. launder clothing:--wash. Compare λούω, νίπτω.

G4193.d: from Πόντος; a Pontican, i.e. native of Pontus:--born in Pontus.

G4362.d: from πρός and πήγνυμι; to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross):--crucify.

G4407.d: from πρωΐ; pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal:--morning.

G4084.d: probably another form of βιάζω; to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture)):--apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take. Compare πιέζω.

G4239.d: apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble:--meek. See also πρᾷος.

G4350.d: from πρός and κόπτω; to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively):--beat upon, dash, stumble (at).

G4491.d: apparently a primary word; a "root" (literally or figuratively):--root.

G4338.d: from πρός and a derivative of ἧλος; to peg to, i.e. spike fast:--nail to.

G4316.d: from πρός and a derivative of ἀγορά (mean to harangue); to address, i.e. salute by name:--call.

G4258.d: from πρό and ἁμαρτάνω; to sin previously (to conversion):--sin already, heretofore sin.

G4289.d: from πρό and θυμός; forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity:--ready, willing.

G4155.d: strengthened from πνέω; to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown):--choke, take by the throat.

G4271.d: from πρό and δῆλος; plain before all men, i.e. obvious:--evident, manifest (open) beforehand.

G4133.d: from πλείων; moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather, yet:--but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.

G4490.d: adverb from a derivative of ῥέω; out-spokenly, i.e. distinctly:--expressly.

G4410.d: from πρῶτος and καθέδρα; a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council:--chief (highest, uppermost) seat.

G4420.d: from a derivative of πέτομαι (meaning a feather); a wing:--wing.

G4212.d: multiplicative from πόσος; how many times:--how oft(-en).

G4391.d: from πρό and ὑπάρχω; to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously:--+ be before(-time).

G4383.d: from πρός and (the visage, from ὀπτάνομαι); the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person:--(outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence.

G4135.d: from πλήρης and φορέω; to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish:--most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of.

G4348.d: from προσκόπτω; a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy:--offence, stumbling(-block, (-stone)).

G4336.d: from πρός and εὔχομαι; to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship:--pray (X earnestly, for), make prayer.

G4098.d: probably akin to πέτομαι through the idea of alighting; to fall (literally or figuratively):--fail, fall (down), light on.

G4301.d: from πρό and λαμβάνω; to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise:--come aforehand, overtake, take before.

G4429.d: a primary verb (compare πτύσσω); to spit:--spit.

G4070.d: adverb from πέρας; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year:--+ a year ago.

G4474.d: from a derivative of a primary (to let fall, "rap"); to slap:--smite (with the palm of the hand). Compare τύπτω.

G4322.d: from πρός and ἀναπληρόω; to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully:--supply.

G4284.d: middle voice from πρό and ἔχω; to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel:--be better.

G4007.d: from the base of πέραν; an enclitic particle significant of abundance (thoroughness), i.e. emphasis; much, very or ever:--(whom-)soever.

G4247.d: feminine of πρεσβύτης; an old woman:--aged woman.

G4066.d: from περί and χώρα; around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with γῆ implied vicinity):--country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about.

G4121.d: from πλείων; to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound:--abound, abundant, make to increase, have over.

G4096.d: from (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of πίνω through the idea of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness (oiliness):--fatness.

G4405.d: feminine of a derivative of πρωΐ as noun; day-dawn:--early, morning.

G4206.d: adverb from πρό; forwards, i.e. at a distance:--far, a great way off. See also πόῤῥωθεν.

G4440.d: from πύλη; a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule:--gate, porch.

G4160.d: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct):--abide, + agree, appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have, hold, X journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, X mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform, provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, X secure, shew, X shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield. Compare πράσσω.

G4251.d: of Latin origin; feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian woman:--Prisca. See also Πρίσκιλλα.

G4095.d: a prolonged form of ; which (together with another form) ; occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; to imbibe (literally or figuratively):--drink.

G4488.d: probably of Hebrew origin (apparently for רְפָיָה); Resa (i.e. Rephajah), an Israelite:--Rhesa.

G4303.d: from πρό and μαρτύρομαι; to be a witness in advance i.e. predict:--testify beforehand.

G4103.d: from πείθω; objectively, trustworthy; subjectively, trustful:--believe(-ing, -r), faithful(-ly), sure, true.

G4075.d: from πέτρα and εἶδος; rock-like, i.e. rocky:--stony.

G4018.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of περιβάλλω; something thrown around one, i.e. a mantle, veil:--covering, vesture.

G4321.d: from πρός and ἀναλίσκω; to expend further:--spend.

G4447.d: from πυρά; fiery, i.e. (by implication) flaming:--of fire.

G4246.d: from the same as πρεσβύτερος; an old man:--aged (man), old man.

G4125.d: of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side:--side.

G4092.d: a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary ; which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fire, i.e. burn (figuratively and passively, become inflamed with fever):--be (X should have) swollen.

G4323.d: from πρός and ἀνατίθεμαι; to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult:--in conference add, confer.

G4106.d: feminine of πλάνος (as abstractly); objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety:--deceit, to deceive, delusion, error.

G4397.d: from προφήτης; pertaining to a foreteller ("prophetic"):--of prophecy, of the prophets.

G4189.d: from πονηρός; depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins:--iniquity, wickedness.

G4128.d: from πλήθω; a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace:--bundle, company, multitude.

G4088.d: from πικρός; acridity (especially poison), literally or figuratively:--bitterness.

G4083.d: of uncertain affinity; the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit:--cubit.

G4406.d: from πρωΐ; dawning, i.e. (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season):--early.

G4080.d: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of πού; how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity:--how great (large).

G4166.d: of uncertain affinity; a shepherd (literally or figuratively):--shepherd, pastor.

G4413.d: contracted superlative of πρό; foremost (in time, place, order or importance):--before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former.

G4044.d: from περί and the base of πέραν; to penetrate entirely, i.e. transfix (figuratively):--pierce through.

G4480.d: of Latin origin; a rheda, i.e. four-wheeled carriage (wagon for riding):--chariot.

G4498.d: probably for rhode (a rose); Rode, a servant girl:--Rhoda.

G4456.d: apparently from (a kind of stone); to petrify, i.e. (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous):-- blind, harden.

G4347.d: from πρός and κολλάω; to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere:--cleave, join (self).

G4304.d: from πρό and μελετάω; to premeditate:--meditate before.

G4441.d: middle voice prolonged from a primary (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to question, i.e. ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from ἐρωτάω, which properly means a request as a favor; and from αἰτέω, which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from ζητέω, which implies a search for something hidden; and from δέομαι, which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence):--ask, demand, enquire, understand.

G4287.d: from πρό and a derivative of τίθημι; fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with ἡμέρα implied) a designated day:--time appointed.

G4190.d: from a derivative of πόνος; hurtful, i.e. evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from κακός, which refers rather to essential character, as well as from σαπρός, which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill, i.e. diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e. derelict, vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural) guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners:--bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness). See also πονηρότερος.

G4408.d: feminine of a presumed derivative of πρό as noun; the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel:--forepart(-ship).

G4309.d: from πρό and ὁρίζω; to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine:--determine before, ordain, predestinate.

G4312.d: from a compound of πρό and πίπτω; falling forward, i.e. headlong (figuratively, precipitate):--heady, rash(-ly).

G4195.d: of Latin origin; a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor:--Pontus.

G4446.d: from πυρέσσω; inflamed, i.e. (by implication) feverish (as noun, fever):--fever.

G4111.d: a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate:--form.

G4113.d: feminine of πλατύς; a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square:--street.

G4399.d: from πρό and φθάνω; to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate:--prevent.

G4495.d: from a derivative of ῥίπτω; to toss up:--cast off.

G4329.d: from προσδοκάω; apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated:--expectation, looking after.

G4400.d: middle voice from πρό and a derivative of χείρ; to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose:--choose, make.

G4100.d: from πίστις; to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to Christ):--believe(-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with.

G4326.d: from πρός and δέομαι; to require additionally, i.e. want further:--need.

G4199.d: prolongation from (to sack); to ravage (figuratively):--destroy, waste.

G4485.d: from ῥήγνυμι; something torn, i.e. a fragment (by implication and abstractly, a fall):--ruin.

G4344.d: neuter of a presumed compound of πρός and κεφαλή; something for the head, i.e. a cushion:--pillow.

G4451.d: from πυρόω; ignition, i.e. (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test):--burning, trial.

G4497.d: of Hebrew origin (רְחַבְעָם); Roboam (i.e. Rechobam), an Israelite:--Roboam.

G4493.d: from ῥίπτω; a jerk (of the eye, i.e. (by analogy) an instant):--twinkling.

G4231.d: from πρᾶγμα; to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade:--occupy.

G4201.d: of Latin origin; apparently swinish; Porcius, a Roman:--Porcius.

G4363.d: from πρός and πίπτω; to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm):--beat upon, fall (down) at (before).

G4072.d: middle voice of a primary verb; to fly:--fly(-ing).

G4234.d: from πράσσω; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function:--deed, office, work.

G4118.d: irregular superlative of πολύς; the largest number or very large:--very great, most.

G4145.d: from πλοῦτος; wealthy; figuratively, abounding with:--rich.

G4039.d: from περί and οἰκέω; to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor:--dwell round about.

G4087.d: from πικρός; to embitter (literally or figuratively):--be (make) bitter.

G4138.d: from πληρόω; repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period):--which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.

G4153.d: adverb from πνευματικός; non-physically, i.e. divinely, figuratively:--spiritually.

G4109.d: from πλάσσω; a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively):--table.

G4283.d: middle voice from πρό and εὐαγγελίζω; to announce glad news in advance:--preach before the gospel.

G4295.d: from πρό and κεῖμαι; to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward):--be first, set before (forth).

G4469.d: of Chaldee origin (compare רֵיק); O empty one, i.e. thou worthless (as a term of utter vilification):--Raca.

G4281.d: from πρό and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time):--go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.

G4471.d: of Hebrew origin (רָמָה); Rama (i.e. Ramah), a place in Palestine:--Rama.

G4143.d: from πλέω; a sailer, i.e. vessel:--ship(-ing).

G4162.d: from ποιέω; action, i.e. performance (of the law):--deed.

G4390.d: from πρό and τρέχω (including its alternate); to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede:--outrun, run before.

G4142.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of πλοῖον; a boat:--boat, little (small) ship.

G4422.d: probably akin to the alternate of πίπτω (through the idea of causing to fall) or to πέτομαι (through that of causing to fly away); to scare:--frighten.

G4215.d: probably from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (compare πότος); a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water:--flood, river, stream, water.

G4486.d: both prolonged forms of (which appears only in certain forms, and is itself probably a strengthened form of agnumi (see in κατάγνυμι)); to "break," "wreck" or "crack", i.e. (especially) to sunder (by separation of the parts; κατάγνυμι being its intensive (with the preposition in composition), and θραύω a shattering to minute fragments; but not a reduction to the constituent particles, like λύω) or disrupt, lacerate; by implication, to convulse (with spasms); figuratively, to give vent to joyful emotions:--break (forth), burst, rend, tear.

G4052.d: from περισσός; to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel:--(make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above).

G4404.d: adverb from πρό; at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch:--early (in the morning), (in the) morning.

G4286.d: from προτίθεμαι; a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God:--purpose, shew(-bread).

G4481.d: by incorrect transliteration for a word of Hebrew origin (כִּיּוּן); Remphan (i.e. Kijun), an Egyptian idol:--Remphan.

G4182.d: from πολύς and ποικίλος; much variegated, i.e. multifarious:--manifold.

G4263.d: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of προβαίνω; something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively):--sheep(-fold).

G4086.d: from a compound of a derivative of πείθω and λόγος; persuasive language:--enticing words.

G4305.d: from πρό and μεριμνάω; to care (anxiously) in advance:--take thought beforehand.

G4367.d: from πρός and τάσσω; to arrange towards, i.e. (figuratively) enjoin:--bid, command.

G4310.d: from πρό and πάσχω; to undergo hardship previously:--suffer before.
r: after that we had suffered before

G4378.d: from a comparative of πρός and (to pour); a shedding forth, i.e. affusion:--sprinkling.

G4172.d: probably from the same as πόλεμος, or perhaps from πολύς; a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size):--city.

G4346.d: from a compound of πρός and κλίνω; a leaning towards, i.e. (figuratively) proclivity (favoritism):--partiality.

G4278.d: from πρό and ἐνάρχομαι; to commence already:--begin (before).

G4041.d: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and εἰμί; being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own):--peculiar.

G4037.d: from περί and μένω; to stay around, i.e. await:--wait for.

G4057.d: adverb from περισσός; superabundantly:--exceedingly, out of measure, the more.

G4393.d: from πρό and φέρω; to bear forward, i.e. produce:--bring forth.

G4361.d: from πρός and the same as πεινάω; hungering further, i.e. intensely hungry:--very hungry.

G4218.d: from the base of πού and τέ; indefinite adverb, at some time, ever:--afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n- )ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when.

G4466.d: of Hebrew origin (רְעוּ); Ragau (i.e. Reu), a patriarch:--Ragau.

G4489.d: from ῥέω; a speaker, i.e. (by implication) a forensic advocate:--orator.

G4249.d: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw); to saw in two:--saw asunder.

G4132.d: prolonged from πλήθω; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet:--flood.

G4477.d: from the same as Ῥαάβ; Rachab, a Canaanitess:--Rachab.

G4167.d: contraction from ποιμαίνω; a flock (literally or figuratively):--flock, fold.

G4376.d: from προσφέρω; presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice:--offering (up).

G4416.d: from πρῶτος and the alternate of τίκτω; first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively):--firstbegotten(-born).

G4238.d: a primary verb; to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from ποιέω, which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally):--commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts.

G4306.d: from πρό and νοιέω; to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself):--provide (for).

G4254.d: from πρό and ἄγω; to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous)):--bring (forth, out), go before.

G4248.d: from πρό; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head foremost:--headlong.

G4021.d: from περί and ἔργον; working all around, i.e. officious (meddlesome, neuter plural magic):--busybody, curious arts.

G4352.d: from πρός and a probable derivative of κύων (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand); to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore):--worship.

G4186.d: from πολύς and τιμή; extremely valuable:--very costly, of great price.

G4059.d: from περί and the base of τομώτερος; to cut around, i.e. (specially) to circumcise:--circumcise.

G4147.d: from πλουτίζω; to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively):--be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.

G4214.d: from an absolute (who, what) and ὅς; interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many):--how great (long, many), what.

G4091.d: of Latin origin; close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman:--Pilate.

G4337.d: from πρός and ἔχω; (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to:--(give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard.

G4341.d: middle voice from πρός and καλέω; to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite:--call (for, to, unto).

G4484.d: of Latin origin; Rhegium, a place in Italy:--Rhegium.

G4434.d: from (to crouch); akin to πτοέω and the alternate of πίπτω); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas πένης properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed):--beggar(-ly), poor.

G4334.d: from πρός and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to:--(as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto).

G4185.d: from πολύς and τέλος; extremely expensive:--costly, very precious, of great price.

G4027.d: from a compound of περί and καθαίρω; something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively):--filth.

G4330.d: from πρός and ἐάω; to permit further progress:--suffer.

G4179.d: from πολύς and probably a derivative of πλέκω; manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more:--manifold more.

G4340.d: from πρός and καιρός; for the occasion only, i.e. temporary:--dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal.

G4129.d: from another form of πλῆθος; to increase (transitively or intransitively):--abound, multiply.

G4163.d: from ποιέω; a performer; specially, a "poet"; --doer, poet.

G4487.d: from ῥέω; an utterance (individually, collectively or specially),; by implication, a matter or topic (especially of narration, command or dispute); with a negative naught whatever:--+ evil, + nothing, saying, word.

G4379.d: from πρός and (to touch); to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve):--touch.

G4307.d: from προνοέω; forethought, i.e. provident care or supply:--providence, provision.

G4226.d: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as πού used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality:--where, whither.

G4455.d: from -πω and ποτέ; at any time, i.e. (with negative particle) at no time:--at any time, + never (…to any man), + yet, never man.

G4051.d: from περισσεύω; a surplus, or superabundance:--abundance, that was left, over and above.

G4156.d: from πνίγω; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled):--strangled.

G4010.d: from πύργος; fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor:--Pergamos.

G4192.d: from the base of πένης; toil, i.e. (by implication) anguish:--pain.

G4194.d: of Latin origin; apparently bridged; Pontius, a Roman:--Pontius.

G4396.d: from a compound of πρό and φημί; a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet:--prophet.

G4076.d: from πήγνυμι; rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves):--rue.

G4370.d: from πρός and τρέχω (including its alternate); to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join:--run (thither to, to).

G4492.d: from ῥίζα; to root (figuratively, become stable):--root.

G4154.d: a primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. breeze:--blow. Compare ψύχω.

G4478.d: of Hebrew origin (רָחֵל); Rachel, the wife of Jacob:--Rachel.

G4015.d: from περί and ἀστράπτω; to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light:--shine round (about).

G4005.d: feminine of the ordinal of πεντήκοντα; fiftieth (ἡμέρα being implied) from Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost":--Pentecost.

G4445.d: from πυρά; to be on fire, i.e. (specially), to have a fever:--be sick of a fever.

G4375.d: from a presumed compound of πρός and φιλέω; friendly towards, i.e. acceptable:--lovely.

G4292.d: middle voice from πρό and καλέω; to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate:--provoke.

G4038.d: adverb from περί; all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent:--round about.

G4437.d: from the same as σκηνοποιός; clasped (thick), i.e. (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently:--often(-er).

G4089.d: perhaps from πήγνυμι (through the idea of piercing); sharp (pungent), i.e. acrid (literally or figuratively):--bitter.

G4442.d: a primary word; "fire" (literally or figuratively, specially, lightning):--fiery, fire.

G4463.d: from ῥάβδος; to strike with a stick, i.e. bastinado:--beat (with rods).

G4453.d: probably ultimately from (to be busy, to trade); to barter (as a pedlar), i.e. to sell:--sell, whatever is sold.

G4359.d: from πρός and ὀφείλω; to be indebted additionally:--over besides.

G4181.d: adverb from a compound of πολύς and μέρος; in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal):--at sundry times.

G4250.d: adverb from πρό; prior, sooner:--before (that), ere.

G4457.d: from πωρόω; stupidity or callousness:--blindness, hardness.

G4392.d: from a compound of πρό and φαίνω; an outward showing, i.e. pretext:--cloke, colour, pretence, show.

G4045.d: from περί and πίπτω; to fall into something that is all around, i.e. light among or upon, be surrounded with:--fall among (into).

G4377.d: from πρός and φωνέω; to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon:--call unto, speak (un-)to.

G4198.d: middle voice from a derivative of the same as πεῖρα; to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.); --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.

G4221.d: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of πίνω; a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate:--cup.

G4123.d: from πλείων and ἔχω; holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder):--covetous.

G4009.d: from the same as πέραν; an extremity:--end, ut-(ter-)most participle

G4213.d: from the alternate of πίνω; a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught:--drink.

G4050.d: from περισσεύω; surplusage, i.e. superabundance:--abundance(-ant, (-ly)), superfluity.

G4207.d: from πόῤῥω with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly:--afar off.

G4224.d: from the alternate of πίνω; a drinking-bout or carousal:--banqueting.

G4000.d: from πεντάκις and χίλιοι; five times a thousand:--five thousand.

G4071.d: neuter of a derivative of πέτομαι; a flying animal, i.e. bird:--bird, fowl.

G4034.d: from περί and λάμπω; to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo:--shine round about.

G4124.d: from πλεονέκτης; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency, extortion:--covetous(-ness) practices, greediness.

G4175.d: from πολιτεύομαι; a community, i.e. (abstractly) citizenship (figuratively):--conversation.

G4364.d: middle voice from πρός and ποιέω; to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing):--make as though.

G4412.d: neuter of πρῶτος as adverb (with or without ὁ); firstly (in time, place, order, or importance):--before, at the beginning, chiefly (at, at the) first (of all).

G4003.d: from πέντε and καί and δέκατος; five and tenth:--fifteenth.

G4170.d: from πόλεμος; to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. to battle (literally or figuratively):--fight, (make) war.

G4029.d: from περί and κεῖμαι; to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively):--be bound (compassed) with, hang about.

G4082.d: of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food:--scrip.

G4253.d: a primary preposition; "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to:--above, ago, before, or ever. In the comparative, it retains the same significations.

G4140.d: from a presumed derivative of πλήθω; a filling up, i.e. (figuratively) gratification:--satisfying.

G4011.d: probably from the same as Πέργαμος; a tower; Perga, a place in Asia Minor:--Perga.

G4314.d: a strengthened form of πρό; a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated):--about, according to , against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in). In the comparative case, it denotes essentially the same applications, namely, motion towards, accession to, or nearness at.

G4223.d: of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy:--Puteoli.

G4436.d: from (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located); a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying):-- divination.

G4014.d: from περί and αἱρέομαι (including its alternate); to remove all around, i.e. unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate:--take away (up).

G4022.d: from περί and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to come all around, i.e. stroll, vacillate, veer:--fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about.

G4288.d: from πρόθυμος; predisposition, i.e. alacrity:--forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.

G4134.d: from πλήθω; replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete:--full.

G4209.d: of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it:--purple.

G4026.d: from περί and ἵστημι; to stand all around, i.e. (near) to be a bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from:--avoid, shun, stand by (round about).

G4183.d: including the forms from the alternate ; (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely:--abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly. Compare πλεῖστος, πλείων.

G4161.d: from ποιέω; a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively):--thing that is made, workmanship.

G4293.d: from πρό and καταγγέλλω; to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise:--foretell, have notice, (shew) before.

G4394.d: from προφήτης ("prophecy"); prediction (scriptural or other):--prophecy, prophesying.

G4105.d: from πλάνη; to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue):--go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way.

G4261.d: from πρό and βάλλω; to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate:--put forward, shoot forth.

G4233.d: from a derivative of πράσσω; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector:--officer.

G4395.d: from προφήτης; to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office:--prophesy.

G4141.d: apparently another form of πλάσσω (through the idea of flattening out); to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity):--smite. Compare τύπτω.

G4432.d: from πτωχεύω; beggary, i.e. indigence (literally or figuratively):--poverty.

G4267.d: from πρό and γινώσκω; to know beforehand, i.e. foresee:--foreknow (ordain), know (before).

G4094.d: apparently a form of πλάξ; a plate:--charger, platter.

G4300.d: from πρό and κυρόω; to ratify previously:--confirm before.

G4033.d: from περί and κυκλόω; to encircle all around, i.e. blockade completely:--compass round.

G4428.d: probably akin to (to spread; and thus apparently allied to πέτομαι through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare πατέω); to fold, i.e. furl a scroll:--close.

G4464.d: from the base of ῥαπίζω; a stick or wand (as a cudgel, a cane or a baton of royalty):--rod, sceptre, staff.

G4285.d: from πρό and ἡγέομαι; to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference:--prefer.

G4137.d: from πλήρης; to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.:--accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply.

G4176.d: middle voice of a derivative of πολίτης; to behave as a citizen (figuratively):--let conversation be, live.

G4025.d: from περιτίθημι; a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself with:--wearing.

G4074.d: apparently a primary word; a (piece of) rock (larger than λίθος); as a name, Petrus, an apostle:--Peter, rock. Compare Κηφᾶς.

G4265.d: from πρό and βλέπω; to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance:--provide.

G4216.d: from ποταμός and a derivative of φορέω; river-borne, i.e. overwhelmed by a stream:--carried away of the flood.

G4345.d: from πρός and κληρόω; to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with:--consort with.

G4308.d: from πρό and ὁράω; to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view:--foresee, see before.

G4079.d: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of (the blade of an oar; from the same as πέδη); a "pedal", i.e. helm:--rudder.

G4260.d: from πρό and the base of βάσις; to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years):--+ be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken.

G4232.d: of Latin origin; the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp):--(common, judgment) hall (of judgment), palace, prætorium.

G4019.d: from περί and δέω; to bind around one, i.e. enwrap:--bind about.

G4065.d: from περί and φρονέω; to think beyond, i.e. depreciate (contemn):--despise.

G4023.d: from περί and ἔχω; to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp (figuratively):--+ astonished, contain, after (this manner).

G4339.d: from the alternate of προσέρχομαι; an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte"):--proselyte.

G4302.d: from πρό and λέγω; to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn:--foretell, tell before.

G4291.d: from πρό and ἵστημι; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise:--maintain, be over, rule.

G4203.d: from πόρνη; to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry:--commit (fornication).

G4119.d: comparative of πολύς; more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion:--X above, + exceed, more excellent, further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but.

G4228.d: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally):--foot(-stool).

G4078.d: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent):--pitch.

G4448.d: from πῦρ; to kindle, i.e. (passively) to be ignited, glow (literally), be refined (by implication), or (figuratively) to be inflamed (with anger, grief, lust):--burn, fiery, be on fire, try.

G4273.d: from προδίδωμι (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands); a surrender:--betrayer, traitor.

G4047.d: from περιποιέομαι; acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension, preservation:--obtain(-ing), peculiar, purchased, possession, saving.

G4040.d: from περί and οἶκος; housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun):--neighbour.

G4369.d: from πρός and τίθημι; to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat:--add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more.

G4159.d: from the base of πόσις with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause:--whence.

G4168.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ποίμνη; a flock, i.e. (figuratively) group (of believers):--flock.

G4360.d: from πρός and a form of (to be vexed with something irksome); to feel indignant at:--be grieved at.

G4384.d: from πρό and τάσσω; to pre-arrange, i.e. prescribe:--before appoint.

G4462.d: of Chaldee origin; corresponding to ῥαββί:--Lord, Rabboni.

G4149.d: from the base of πλήθω; wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment:--riches.

G4276.d: from πρό and ἐλπίζω; to hope in advance of other confirmation:--first trust.

G4371.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of πρός and φάγω; something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare ὀψάριον):--meat.

G4060.d: from περί and τίθημι; to place around; by implication, to present:--bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about.

G4031.d: from περί and κράτος; strong all around, i.e. a master (manager):--+ come by.

G4435.d: from a primary (the fist as a weapon); the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing):--oft.

G4403.d: feminine of (hindmost); the stern of a ship:--hinder part, stern.

G4313.d: from πρό and πορεύομαι; to precede (as guide or herald):--go before.

G4205.d: from (to sell; akin to the base of πιπράσκω); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine):--fornicator, whoremonger.

G4430.d: from the alternate of πίπτω; a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion):--dead body, carcase, corpse.

G4102.d: from πείθω; persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth itself:--assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity.

G4411.d: from πρῶτος and κλισία; a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e. preeminence at meals:--chief (highest, uppermost) room.

G4365.d: from πρός and πορεύομαι; to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as προπορεύομαι):--go before.

G4479.d: of Hebrew origin (רִבְקָה); Rebecca (i.e. Ribkah), the wife of Isaac:--Rebecca.

G4210.d: from πορφύρα; purpureal, i.e. bluish red:--purple.

G4317.d: from πρός and ἄγω; to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach:--bring, draw near.

G4401.d: from πρό and χειροτονέω; to elect in advance:--choose before.

G4001.d: from πέντε and ἑκατόν; five hundred:--five hundred.

G4117.d: from πλέκω; a plait (of hair):--broidered hair.

G4152.d: from πνεῦμα; non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (dæmoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious:--spiritual. Compare ψυχικός.

G4388.d: middle voice from πρό and τίθημι; to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine):--purpose, set forth.

G4116.d: from πλάσσω; spread out "flat" ("plot"), i.e. broad:--wide.

G4496.d: a primary verb (perhaps rather akin to the base of ῥαπίζω, through the idea of sudden motion); to fling (properly, with a quick toss, thus differing from βάλλω, which denotes a deliberate hurl; and from (see in ἐκτείνω), which indicates an extended projection); by qualification, to deposit (as if a load); by extension, to disperse:--cast (down, out), scatter abroad, throw.

G4366.d: from πρός and ῥήγνυμι; to tear towards, i.e. burst upon (as a tempest or flood):--beat vehemently against (upon).

G4240.d: from πραΰς; mildness, i.e. (by implication) humility:--meekness.

G4006.d: from the perfect of the alternate of πάσχω; reliance:--confidence, trust.

G4402.d: from πρό and χορός; before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian:--Prochorus.

G4217.d: apparently from πότε and the base of ποῦ; interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort:--what (manner of).

G4032.d: from περί and κρύπτω; to conceal all around, i.e. entirely:--hide.

G4354.d: from πρός and λαλέω; to talk to, i.e. converse with:--speak to (with).

G4262.d: from πρόβατον; relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem:--sheep (market).

G4180.d: from a compound of πολύς and λόγος; loquacity, i.e. prolixity:--much speaking.

G4472.d: from a derivative of (to sprinkle); to render besprinkled, i.e. asperse (ceremonially or figuratively):-- sprinkle.

G4061.d: from περιτέμνω; circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively):--X circumcised, circumcision.

G4328.d: from πρός and dokeuo (to watch); to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await:--(be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for.

G4245.d: comparative of (elderly); older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter":-- elder(-est), old.

G4425.d: from πτύω; a winnowing-fork (as scattering like spittle):--fan.

G4120.d: a primary word; to twine or braid:--plait.

G4085.d: another form for πιάζω; to pack:--press down.

G4158.d: from πούς and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress (ἐσθής implied) reaching the ankles:--garment down to the foot.

G4028.d: from περί and καλύπτω; to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface):--blindfold, cover, overlay.

G4255.d: from πρό and αἱρέομαι; to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend):--purpose.

G4139.d: neuter of a derivative of (near); (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or friend):--near, neighbour.

G4030.d: feminine of a compound of περί and κεφαλή; encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet:--helmet.

G4063.d: from περί and τρέχω (including its alternate); to run around, i.e. traverse:--run through.

G4202.d: from πορνεύω; harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry:--fornication.

G4380.d: from προσωπολήπτης; to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality:--have respect to persons.

G4426.d: from a presumed derivative of πτύω (and thus akin to πτοέω); to frighten:--terrify.

G4381.d: from πρόσωπον and λαμβάνω; an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality:--respecter of persons.

G4237.d: perhaps from (a leek, and so an onion-patch); a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement):--in ranks.

G4257.d: from πρό and ἀκούω; to hear already,i.e. anticipate:--hear before.

G4424.d: from (Ptolemy, after whom it was named); Ptolemais, a place in Palestine:--Ptolemais.

G4099.d: probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pisidia.

G4219.d: from the base of ποῦ and τέ; interrogative adverb, at what time:--+ how long, when.

G4036.d: from περί and λύπη; grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad:--exceeding (very) sorry(-owful).

G4274.d: from the alternate of προτρέχω; a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor):--forerunner.

G4431.d: from the alternate of πίπτω; a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively):--fall.

G4169.d: from the base of ποῦ and οἷος; individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one:--what (manner of), which.

G4438.d: from a derivative of the same as πυγμή; to box (with the fist), i.e. contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively):--fight.

G4299.d: from a compound of πρό and κρίνω; a prejudgment (prejudice), i.e. prepossession:--prefer one before another.

G4264.d: from πρό and a reduplicated form of βιάζω; to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate:--draw, before instruct.

G4372.d: from πρό and a derivative of σφάζω; previously (recently) slain (fresh), i.e. (figuratively) lately made:--new.

G4417.d: a form of πίπτω; to trip, i.e. (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation):--fall, offend, stumble.

G4242.d: from πρεσβεύω; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors):--ambassage, message.

G4077.d: probably from πήγνυμι (through the idea of gushing plumply); a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring):--fountain, well.

G4482.d: a primary verb; for some tenses of which a prolonged form is used to flow ("run"; as water):--flow.

G4450.d: from πῦρ; fire-like, i.e. (specially), flame- colored:--red.

G4266.d: from πρό and γίνομαι; to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired:--be past.

G4093.d: diminutive of πίναξ; a tablet (for writing on):--writing table.

G4073.d: feminine of the same as Πέτρος; a (mass of) rock (literally or figuratively):--rock.

G4222.d: from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω; to furnish drink, irrigate:--give (make) to drink, feed, water.

G4467.d: from a comparative of (easy, i.e. reckless) and ἔργον; easy-going behavior, i.e. (by extension) a crime:--lewdness.

G4297.d: from προκόπτω; progress, i.e. advancement (subjectively or objectively):--furtherance, profit.

G4122.d: from πλεονέκτης; to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach:--get an advantage, defraud, make a gain.

G4157.d: from πνέω; respiration, a breeze:--breath, wind.

G4355.d: from πρός and λαμβάνω; to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality):--receive, take (unto).

G4298.d: from πρό and κόπτω; to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along):--increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.

G4126.d: probably a form of πλύνω (through the idea of plunging through the water); to pass in a vessel:--sail. See also πλήθω.

G4409.d: from πρῶτος; to be first (in rank or influence):--have the preeminence.

G4188.d: from the alternate of πίνω; a beverage:--drink.

G4419.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of πτέρυξ; a winglet, i.e. (figuratively) extremity (top corner):--pinnacle.

G4062.d: from περί and the base of τροπή; to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze:--+ make mad.
